summary: prepareUpdate is implemented and the update path now carries an Update container from translation to evaluation. Changes: Update(prologue, algebra) container in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py always returns an Update, building the prologue from the single declaration group before the empty-request exit; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate in processor.py mirrors prepareQuery; prepareUpdate is exported from the sparql package; test/test_sparql_prepare.py adds 13 tests. Nothing was run, per the instructions (read/edit only), and nothing was committed. Black formatting was checked by hand only, not with black. The initial-bindings test relies on an empty WHERE pattern passing initial bindings through; that is the test to check first when the suite runs.
